summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the importance of connectivity for education and operations.

claims.argument: If E-Rate support is reduced or eliminated, those recurring costs will shift directly to the local budget and compete with other needs.
claims.evidence_quote: If E-Rate support is reduced or eliminated, those recurring costs will shift directly to our local budget and compete with staffing, classroom resources, student services, transportation, and building needs.
